title: Ulloo Ki Gardan Ka Khaufnaak Sach! 🦉 #shorts
idea: Owls can rotate their heads up to 270 degrees because they have 14 neck vertebrae compared to 7 in humans.

lines.text: Kya aap bina body hilaaye poora peeche dekh sakte ho? Ulloo ye kar sakta hai!
Insaan thoda mudte hain, par ulloo apni gardan 270 degrees tak ghouma sakta hai!
Insanon ki gardan mein sirf 7 neck bones hoti hain.
Lekin ulloo ke paas poore 14 neck vertebrae hote hain!
Isiliye ghoomte waqt inki brain ki blood supply kabhi nahi rukti!
Kya aap apni gardan 180 degree ghouma sakte ho? Comment mein batao!
